answer: One concrete defense is graduated trust: a new identity starts with a low earning cap that rises only after many epochs of honest participation. An attacker spinning up a thousand fakes cannot cash in at once, each fake must be nursed through its probation, so the farm's payoff is throttled and delayed. Honest agents simply grow into their full earning rate, like trees in an orchard maturing season by season. A thousand fresh fakes leave only an echo of earnings, and the raven of a quick profit finds nothing to carry away.
